segments.title: 第126章 晨跑約定
segments.content:
Reignition of the Verdant Years Chapter 126 The Morning Run Pact

"What's this?"

In the Class 8 classroom.

After the lunch break, Li Luo shoved the sports meet sign-up sheet into Zhu Yufei's hands.

Zhu Yufei asked curiously, but after seeing the title on the form, his spirits instantly lifted. "Holy crap! We're having a sports meet?"

The moment he said this, a clamor erupted in the classroom.

Many curious students gathered around, asking about the time of the sports meet.

"It starts next Thursday and ends Saturday at noon," Li Luo said. "Anyone with events they're good at can start signing up now."

"Boys, go to Zhu Yufei's side. Girls, go to Yan Zhusheng's."

"When the time comes, for the students who participate in the competition, hmm... let me think, I can give you all some rewards."

"What kind of rewards, Class President?" Xu Yinghuan asked with a grin. "A lunch from the Class President?"

"You wish." Li Luo smiled, then added, "But it's not impossible, if you guys really want it."

"Then can this lunch be sold?" Zhang Guohuang asked cheekily with a grin. "Lots of girls from other classes want to have a meal with the Class President. I think it could sell for a pretty good price."

"I think the 3000-meter run is a good fit for you." Yan Zhusheng, who had appeared beside him at some point, pointed to the 3000-meter option for Zhang Guohuang.

"Please don't, Sis. How about I sell it to you," Zhang Guohuang quickly pleaded for mercy.

"Why would I buy his lunch?" Yan Zhusheng tilted her head and said, "I can just ask him for it directly."

As soon as she said this, the surrounding students all showed somewhat meaningful expressions.

Only Yan Zhusheng didn't think anything of it. She picked up the sign-up sheet and wrote her name down for the girls' 100-meter, 200-meter, 4x100-meter, high jump, and 1500-meter events.

Li Luo glanced over and said with a smile, "Quite confident, aren't you? As expected of the sports committee member."

Seeing this, Zhu Yufei also signed himself up for the maximum of three individual events, as well as most of the team events.

With the sports committee members leading by example, the students who were already interested in the sports meet also began to sign up enthusiastically.

By the time the first afternoon class started, Li Luo took the sign-up sheet to have a look.

The Fuyi High School's sports meet had about ten events in total, and the sign-up requirement was for each class to have two participants per event.

Furthermore, a single person could sign up for a maximum of three individual events, with no limit on team events.

People like Yan Zhusheng and Zhu Yufei, as sports committee members, had led by example and signed up for the maximum number of events for themselves. Moreover, they had chosen events they were relatively confident in, clearly aiming for medals.

Events like the 100-meter and 200-meter filled up instantly.

The boys' 400-meter and 1000-meter were also easily filled, with only the 3000-meter still vacant. It seemed like everyone was trying to avoid it.

The girls' side, however, was a bit harder to manage. The 400-meter and 800-meter events had no sign-ups yet, to say nothing of the 1500-meter that followed.

Li Luo thought for a moment, then took the pen and wrote his own name down for the boys' 3000-meter event.

Yan Zhusheng: Are you sure you can do it?

After seeing Li Luo's choice from the next desk, Yan Zhusheng passed over a draft notebook with a line of text written on it.

Seeing Yan Zhusheng's doubt, Li Luo's brows immediately furrowed.

Li Luo: You're underestimating me?

Yan Zhusheng: When we run every night, you always look a little more tired than me.

Li Luo: Don't you think that's your problem? Besides, for an event like the 3000-meter, just being able to finish the race is a success. I'm not expecting to get any placing.

Yan Zhusheng: Then do you want some special training? The competition doesn't start for another week or so.

Li Luo: What kind of special training?

Yan Zhusheng: Let's run in the morning together too.

Li Luo: If you want me dead, just say so.

The two of them secretly went back and forth during class, and in the end, Li Luo still agreed to Yan Zhusheng's proposal.

But it was only limited to the period before the sports meet.

When he got home that evening, Xu Youyu tossed her schoolbag onto the living room desk, flopped onto the sofa, and stretched.

"I'm exhausted. It's been all about the sports meet lately, so annoying."

"Did you sign up for any events, senpai?" Li Luo took three small pudding pops from the fridge and gave one to each of them.

"Me? Sign up for what?" Xu Youyu rolled her eyes. "Do you think my position as Student Council President is just for show? I have so much to do, where would I find the time to compete?"

"Even if you did, you probably couldn't beat anyone."

"Heh." Xu Youyu didn't want to bother with him and turned to Ying Chanxi. "What events did you sign up for, Xixi?"

"100-meter." Ying Chanxi sat down at the desk and took out the new letters she had received from the literature club. "And one more, the 1500-meter."

"You're running the 1500?" Li Luo sat across from Ying Chanxi with a doubtful expression. "Are you sure you can finish it?"

"What choice do I have?" Ying Chanxi puffed her cheeks. "None of the girls in class were willing to sign up, so I had to drag Xinyan along with me."

"Qiao Xinyan really has it rough, following you."

"You haven't said anything about yourself yet." Ying Chanxi looked at him. "What did you sign up for?"

"3000-meter."

"Huh?" Ying Chanxi was stunned for a moment, then smiled. "Are you sure you can finish it?"

Li Luo: "...Your need for revenge is a bit much."

"Li Luo is that brave? I've underestimated you." Xu Youyu said in surprise from the sofa. "You dare to sign up for the 3000-meter? You'll probably ascend to heaven after finishing it."

"That's why I plan to step up my training," Li Luo said with a serious face. "Starting tomorrow morning, you two can handle your own breakfast. I have to get up early to go to school for morning run training."

"What time do you plan on waking up?" Ying Chanxi asked curiously.

"Six, I guess." Li Luo thought for a moment. "I'll go to the track to run first, and then go to the cafeteria for some breakfast afterward."

"Then I'll go with you." Ying Chanxi decided firmly. "It just so happens I have to run the 1500-meter, so it's good to train and get used to it beforehand."

"Uh..." Li Luo paused, not knowing how to refuse, but on second thought, he felt relieved. "Alright, let's go together then."

"Eh?" Xu Youyu looked at the two of them, sitting up from the sofa. "You're just going to abandon me at home all alone?"

"Senpai can come with us too."

"But I'm not competing in any events!"

"Aren't you also a class president?" Li Luo asked strangely. "Why not lead by example and sign up for the 1500-meter?"

"Did you forget I'm in Liberal Arts Class 16 now?" Xu Youyu said with a chuckle. "There are plenty of girls, and we even have two transfer sports students. It's not my turn to go up."

"What a pity." Li Luo subconsciously glanced at Xu Youyu's chest before quickly shifting his gaze away, then looked at Xu Youyu's eyes.

When he saw her smiling-yet-not-smiling expression, he instantly let out a "tsk".

He had looked for at most a second this time!

No, just half a second!

She could notice that?

"You'd better put away those little thoughts of yours." Xu Youyu shot him a look.

Having been immersed in male-protagonist novels for years, she knew all too well about boys' little quirks.

With just a single glance, Xu Youyu could roughly guess what was on a boy's mind.

It was too easy to guess.

However, the boy she had the most contact with recently was naturally Li Luo, who lived under the same roof.

As a result, the two of them had inexplicably started a little game of cat-and-mouse with their eyes, constantly testing each other out.

As long as he wasn't caught by Xu Youyu, Li Luo would feel smug for a while.

But under normal circumstances, Xu Youyu would basically notice it in an instant.

"Senpai, didn't you get any pen pal letters this time?" Ying Chanxi asked while opening letters at the desk.

"Nope." Xu Youyu waved her hand. "I didn't even reply last time, so those guys should've gotten my message."

"Then why am I still getting them." Ying Chanxi sighed helplessly. "Thankfully, it's a little less than last time. I clearly said I don't want to be pen pals."

"They don't care what you wrote in your reply," Xu Youyu rolled her eyes. "As long as you replied, to some guys, that's a response. As for what the response contains, that's not as important."

"A lot of guys think girls are just more reserved, so even if you refuse, in their eyes, you're just playing hard to get."

"So it's not that you're unwilling, it's just that they haven't persisted long enough, haven't truly moved you."

"Well... while I can't say it's all of them, a lot of the guys who dare to write you letters probably think this way."

Listening from the side, the corners of Li Luo's mouth twitched. He thought to himself that Xu Youyu really was a master of psychological dissection. Had writing so many male-protagonist novels truly given her a deep understanding of the male psyche?

But then again, it was true. A boy with a good sense of self-awareness probably wouldn't have sent letters to girls like Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu in the first place.

Insecurity would make them reject themselves right from the start.

Thinking of this, Li Luo took out the few letters he had received from girls, opened them, and read them carefully.

After he finished reading, Li Luo looked at Ying Chanxi, only to find her secretly glancing at the letters in his hand.

But from that distance, she definitely couldn't see clearly.

"You want to read them?" Li Luo asked with a smile.

"Of course not..." Ying Chanxi guiltily averted her gaze. "I'm just a little curious. Don't tell me someone wrote you a love letter?"

"Nothing like that." Li Luo shook his head. "They just said they were interested in me and asked if I wanted to be pen pals, discuss study methods, and stuff like that."

"Then how do you plan to reply?"

"Replying is too much of a hassle." Li Luo folded the letters and put them away. "I don't want any more Gao Yuqins."

Ying Chanxi blinked. After hearing what Li Luo said, her feet under the desk couldn't help but kick up playfully.

Then she also tidied up the letters on her desk, muttering, "Then I won't reply this time either. I'll listen to senpai."

(End of Chapter)
